fluff.overview: The Concordat Frigate was the Taurian Concordat's principal domestically designed WarShip, conceived during an era of growing territorial pressure from the Inner Sphere's Great Houses. Concordat Aerospace Limited developed the class to bridge the gap between corvette and destroyer classifications, producing a vessel intended to serve dual roles as a patrol ship for the Concordat's vast frontier space lanes and as a task force command ship capable of direct engagement with enemy capital vessels. The design reflected a distinctly Periphery approach to naval architecture, compensating for smaller fleet sizes with concentrated firepower packed into a hull suited to the Concordat's limited shipbuilding capacity. The Concordat Frigate occupied a critical strategic niche as both a deterrent against Great House aggression and a frontline combatant should deterrence fail.
fluff.capabilities:
The Concordat Frigate's armament reflects a design philosophy prioritizing forward-facing firepower for aggressive engagement. Fifteen NAC/20 naval autocannons form the primary anti-ship battery, with the heaviest concentrations in the broadside arcs and supplementary coverage forward and aft. These medium-caliber weapons deliver enough firepower to threaten even Star League battleships at close range. Three NL55 naval lasers in the nose provide long-range striking power, supplemented by four NL45 tubes covering the forward quarter arcs for sustained energy engagement during approach.

The secondary armament comprises thirty-two LRM 15 launchers, sixteen large lasers, and thirty-two medium lasers distributed in overlapping arcs across the entire hull, creating a comprehensive defensive screen against fighters and DropShips. Standard armor totaling 527.5 tons provides adequate hull protection for the vessel's displacement class.

The vessel's bay configuration reflects its role as a task force command ship rather than a standalone combatant. Eight small craft provide utility transport and marine delivery capability, while four docking collars allow the Concordat to anchor a mixed task force of assault DropShips and fighter carriers. A single 130-meter gravity deck and substantial cargo capacity exceeding fifty thousand tons support extended patrol deployments in frontier territories where resupply infrastructure may be limited. Crew accommodations include facilities for sixty marines organized in two platoons for boarding operations and inspection duties.
fluff.deployment:
The first of class, TCS Concordat, launched from Concordat Aerospace Limited's Taurus yards in 2506 and served as the namesake for what would become the largest WarShip fleet in the Periphery. The vessel's early career established operational patterns that subsequent crews followed for generations of frontier patrol duty.

Among the most documented individual vessels were those assigned to II Corps of the Taurian Defense Force in 2765. The TCS Marantha Calderon supported the Hyades Guards along the Federated Suns border, while the TCS Parilicium operated alongside the Hyades Cavalry and the TCS Parin accompanied the Hyades Light Infantry. All three provided rapid-deployment capability for their respective regiments. The Periphery Uprising of 2766 destroyed both the Marantha Calderon and the Parilicium along with virtually every other Concordat-class vessel still in service.

The TCS Parin alone escaped destruction, becoming the last operational WarShip in the entire Taurian Navy. Stationed at Flannagan's Nebulea, the Parin remained in reserve during the Taurian-Canopian War of 2813-2814, too valuable to risk in combat against the Magistracy. The vessel was lost at some point during the First Succession War, ending the class's operational history.

The Magistracy of Canopus operated one Concordat-class vessel, the MCS Fury, which had been recently refurbished as of 2765. The Fury was destroyed during the Periphery Uprising alongside its Taurian counterparts.
fluff.history:
The Concordat Frigate traces its origins to the early twenty-sixth century, when the Taurian Concordat found itself facing increasing territorial pressure from both the Capellan Confederation and the Federated Suns as those Great Houses expanded their borders outward toward the Periphery. Recognizing the need for a WarShip that could both patrol the vast expanse of Periphery space lanes and directly engage enemy capital ships, Taurian naval architects conceived a vessel that would bridge the corvette and destroyer classifications.

Concordat Aerospace Limited, operating from facilities distributed throughout the Hyades Cluster, undertook production of the new design. While multiple CAL facilities could service WarShips and manufacture DropShips, only the Taurus shipyard possessed the capability to produce WarShip hulls. The first vessel launched from these yards and entered service in 2506. Liberty Naval Yards at Horsham provided additional construction capacity for the class.

The design philosophy reflected a distinctly Periphery approach to naval warfare. Unable to match the sheer numbers of Inner Sphere fleets, Taurian naval architects concentrated formidable capital armament into a relatively compact hull, creating a vessel that could threaten even larger adversaries while maintaining comprehensive defensive coverage. This aggressive posture demanded certain compromises in protection, but the combination of forward-firing power and distributed secondary batteries gave task force commanders a capable centerpiece for combined-arms operations.

Over four dozen Concordat-class frigates entered service before the Reunification War, giving the Taurian Concordat the largest WarShip fleet in the Periphery. The class also served the Magistracy of Canopus, whose navy operated at least one vessel. During the Reunification War, eight frigates formed the backbone of Task Force AMBER at the Battle of Tentativa in 2577, engaging Federated Suns naval forces across multiple star systems. The Taurian navy achieved several remarkable successes during the conflict, but ultimately could not prevail against the Star League's vastly superior numbers and technology.

No additional vessels were constructed after the war's end, but the surviving frigates continued to serve. By 2765, seven remained active: six in Taurian service and one in the Magistracy of Canopus. Three Taurian vessels were assigned to II Corps along the Federated Suns border, each supporting a specific regiment for rapid deployment. A new production facility had been established on Taurus in the 2750s, but it was destroyed during the upheaval of the Amaris Coup. The SLDF annihilated virtually all Periphery WarShip fleets during the 2766 Periphery Uprising, destroying nearly every surviving Concordat-class vessel. Only one frigate is known to have escaped the devastation, serving as the last operational WarShip in the Taurian Navy before being lost during the First Succession War. The class's three-century service history came to an end with no known surviving examples.
